topic: Pay Off Credit Cards or Other High Interest Debt
source_evidence: Every time you use a credit card, track how much you have spent and figure out how much you’ll have to pay that month.
question: Misconception: I don’t need to track individual credit card purchases because I can wait until the bill arrives to see what I owe.
answer: Track each credit card purchase as you make it and keep a running total of what you’ll need to pay that month. The source notes that it’s easy to forget how much you’ve charged, so tracking can help you know what you owe.
